title: eludite.editor.format_document input
description: Format a document (Edit > Advanced > Format Document, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+D) with the formatter the setting editor.formatter chooses: the project's Prettier or Biome run out of process on the document's text, else the language server's textDocument/formatting. The result applies as one undo step; the document is not saved. A formatter that fails leaves the document unchanged, writes an Output line and answers with `applied` false and its message.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.
